lines.t: I wandered far, chased some shadows in the night
Stacking treasures that don't shine in your light
Empty hands, heavy heart, a soul grown cold
But I hear your voice calling me home
All the walls I've built, all the lies I've known
Fall like dust, I'm not afraid to let them go
I'm coming back
I'm leaving this whole world behind
I'm coming back
Breaking stained glass that confines
No more peering through cracks
No more hiding in the dark
I'm coming back to you, Lord
You've always held my heart
The world promised me gold, but gave me rust
Whispers of joy, but I could never trust
Every step away only pulled me down
Now I lift my eyes, I'm coming around
All the chains of pride on the walls of fear
Shatter in the light, your mercy draws me near
I'm coming back
I'm leaving this void behind
I'm coming back
Breaking stained glass that can't find
No more peering through cracks, no more hiding in the dark
I'm coming back to you, you've always held my heart
Here I am, all I am is yours
Every road I walked led me to your doors
No treasure in this world could compare to this
Your endless love, your forgiving kiss
I'm coming back
I'm leaving this world behind
I'm coming back
You healed me so I'm no longer blind
No more wandering in the dark
I can finally see
You have always loved me
I'm coming back
